section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS) used to measure positive body image in the study. The study employed a 10-item version of the BAS (not the newer BAS-2) with items rated on a 5-point scale, achieving a Cronbach alpha of .89. The section explains that the Brazilian Portuguese translation was validated using only 10 of the original 13 items, and the BAS-2 was not available at the time the study began.
